title: Primes or Palindromes?
statementMd:
Rikhail Mubinchik believes that the current definition of prime numbers is obsolete as they are too complex and unpredictable. A palindromic number is another matter. It is aesthetically pleasing, and it has a number of remarkable properties. Help Rikhail to convince the scientific community in this!

Let us remind you that a number is called *prime* if it is integer larger than one, and is not divisible by any positive integer other than itself and one.

Rikhail calls a number a *palindromic* if it is integer, positive, and its decimal representation without leading zeros is a palindrome, i.e. reads the same from left to right and right to left.

One problem with prime numbers is that there are too many of them. Let's introduce the following notation: $π(*n*)$ — the number of primes no larger than $*n*$, $*rub*(*n*)$ — the number of palindromic numbers no larger than $*n*$. Rikhail wants to prove that there are a lot more primes than palindromic ones.

He asked you to solve the following problem: for a given value of the coefficient $*A*$ find the maximum $*n*$, such that $π(*n*) ≤ *A*·*rub*(*n*)$.

## Input

The input consists of two positive integers $*p*$, $*q*$, the numerator and denominator of the fraction that is the value of $*A*$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/041bd986f782f4473b6391bc9e8fd014d9ba53f8.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/33b89d29647f62d25a0dad09f24bb0db3ba22b17.png)).

## Output

If such maximum number exists, then print it. Otherwise, print `"Palindromic tree is better than splay tree"` (without the quotes).
statementZhMd:
Rikhail Mubinchik 认为，当前的质数定义已经过时了，因为质数太复杂且难以预测。回文数则是另一回事。它在美学上令人愉悦，并且具有许多显著的性质。请帮助 Rikhail 说服科学界相信这一点！

让我们回顾一下：如果一个整数大于 1，且不能被除自身和 1 以外的任何正整数整除，则称其为*质数*。

Rikhail 将满足以下条件的数称为*回文数*：它是一个正整数，且其不含前导零的十进制表示是回文，也就是说，从左向右读和从右向左读完全相同。

质数存在的一个问题是它们太多了。我们引入以下记号：$π(*n*)$ 表示不大于 $*n*$ 的质数数量，$*rub*(*n*)$ 表示不大于 $*n*$ 的回文数数量。Rikhail 想要证明，质数的数量远多于回文数。

他请你解决以下问题：给定系数 $*A*$，求满足 $π(*n*) ≤ *A*·*rub*(*n*)$ 的最大 $*n*$。

## 输入格式

输入包含两个正整数 $*p*$、$*q*$，它们分别是分数值 $*A*$ 的分子和分母（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/041bd986f782f4473b6391bc9e8fd014d9ba53f8.png)，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/33b89d29647f62d25a0dad09f24bb0db3ba22b17.png)）。

## 输出格式

如果这样的最大数存在，则输出它。否则，输出 `"Palindromic tree is better than splay tree"`（不含引号）。
